title: The Tower of Pointy Opinions
done: You built the Tower of Pointy Opinions! The tall one thinks it is right. The short one thinks so too.

steps.say: The tall tower: stand 3 squares in a triangle, each one joined to the last.
The short tower: stand 2 squares in a triangle, sharing a wall, so the two towers hold each other steady, each one joined to the last.
The towers: stand corner triangles out from the corners, the straight side against the corner: feet.
